metadata.name: Malaysian Medical Billing Bundling Rules
sources: PHFSA Regulations 2006 (Schedule 13) and MMA MPSN 5th Edition v2.0 (2020)

metadata.description: Tiered bundling rules defining items and procedure combinations that should NOT be billed as separate line items. Used to detect unbundling and miscoding in Malaysian private hospital bills.

tier_definitions.TIER_1: PAC Officially Confirmed — stated verbatim in Parliament, June 25, 2026. Highest evidential weight.
tier_definitions.TIER_2: On Record in PAC 1,999-Page Report — Hansard testimony, parliamentary record. Strong evidential weight.
tier_definitions.TIER_3: Documented by Health Experts and Media — credible published sources. Moderate evidential weight.
tier_definitions.TIER_4: Standard Medical Billing Unbundling — industry-standard checks for lab panels and procedure pairs.
tier_definitions.TIER_5: Price Discrimination Flag — PAC-documented pattern, not unbundling but related overcharging concern.

flag_message_templates.TIER_1: Parliament's Public Accounts Committee (June 2026) found this item should be included in your room charge, not billed separately.
flag_message_templates.TIER_2: This charge has been identified by health experts and parliamentary testimony as a potential unbundling concern — worth querying with your hospital.
flag_message_templates.TIER_3: This charge has been identified by health experts and parliamentary testimony as a potential unbundling concern — worth querying with your hospital.
flag_message_templates.TIER_4: This appears to be a component of a standard test panel that is typically billed as a single charge — ask your hospital why it appears separately.
flag_message_templates.TIER_5: PAC found that GL patients are sometimes charged more than cash patients for the same treatment. Ask your hospital for the cash-equivalent rate.

IMPORTANT_READ_FIRST: Never label any Tier 2-5 flag as illegal. Only Tier 1 items have explicit parliamentary confirmation.
Based on PHFSA Schedule 13: all charges shown are maximum chargeable charges.
Surgical rule: when two procedures are performed through the same incision, the lesser should not exceed 50% of its normal fee.

items.condition: Charged at inflated unit price (e.g. RM20/pair when market price is ~RM0.50/pair from a box of 100 at ~RM50).
items.benchmark: A box of 100 gloves costs ~RM50 in the market (~RM0.50 per pair). Flag if billed at RM5+ per pair.
items.source: Galen Centre CEO, MCA Deputy President Dr Mah Hang Soon (public statements)

tier_4_billing_standard.description: Industry-standard unbundling checks for lab panels and procedure pairs.
tier_4_billing_standard.flag_message: This appears to be a component of a standard test panel that is typically billed as a single charge — ask your hospital why it appears separately.

lab_panel_rules.condition: One or more individual FBC components appear as separate line items instead of a single FBC panel charge.
One or more individual LFT components appear as separate line items instead of a single LFT panel charge.
One or more individual RFT components appear as separate line items instead of a single RFT panel charge.
One or more individual lipid components appear as separate line items instead of a single lipid panel charge.

procedure_pair_rules.description: ECG recording and ECG interpretation both billed separately.
procedure_pair_rules.condition: Both appear on the same bill billed by the same doctor on the same date.
procedure_pair_rules.flag_message: This appears to be a component of a standard test panel that is typically billed as a single charge — ask your hospital why it appears separately.

procedure_pair_rules.description: Specialist ward visit and outpatient consultation both billed on the same date.
procedure_pair_rules.condition: Both billed on the same date for the same specialist.
procedure_pair_rules.flag_message: This charge has been identified by health experts and parliamentary testimony as a potential unbundling concern — worth querying with your hospital.

procedure_pair_rules.description: IV line insertion fee and IV line maintenance fee both billed separately.
procedure_pair_rules.condition: Both appear on the same bill on the same date.
procedure_pair_rules.flag_message: This appears to be a component of a standard test panel that is typically billed as a single charge — ask your hospital why it appears separately.

procedure_pair_rules.description: Wound suture fee and suture removal fee both billed separately.
procedure_pair_rules.condition: Both billed by the same facility within the normal healing window (7-14 days).
procedure_pair_rules.flag_message: This appears to be a component of a standard test panel that is typically billed as a single charge — ask your hospital why it appears separately.

procedure_pair_rules.description: Anaesthesia pre-assessment fee and surgical anaesthesia fee both billed separately.
procedure_pair_rules.condition: Routine pre-op check by the same anaesthetist billed separately just before surgery.
procedure_pair_rules.flag_message: This appears to be a component of a standard test panel that is typically billed as a single charge — ask your hospital why it appears separately.

procedure_pair_rules.description: Wound dressing charge and nursing care charge both billed on the same day.
procedure_pair_rules.condition: Both billed on the same day during inpatient stay for non-complex wounds.
procedure_pair_rules.flag_message: This appears to be a component of a standard test panel that is typically billed as a single charge — ask your hospital why it appears separately.

procedure_pair_rules.description: Duplicate drug entries — same active molecule billed under different brand names.
procedure_pair_rules.condition: Same active ingredient (e.g. Paracetamol) billed under two different brand names on the same date without clinical justification.
procedure_pair_rules.flag_message: This appears to be a component of a standard test panel that is typically billed as a single charge — ask your hospital why it appears separately.

procedure_pair_rules.description: Two surgical procedures performed through the same incision — lesser must not exceed 50% of major.
procedure_pair_rules.condition: Two procedures billed at full fee through the same surgical incision site.
procedure_pair_rules.flag_message: This appears to be a component of a standard test panel that is typically billed as a single charge — ask your hospital why it appears separately.
procedure_pair_rules.regulatory_rule: When two procedures are performed through the same incision, the fee for the lesser procedure must not exceed 50% of its normal Schedule 13 maximum fee.

tier_5_price_discrimination.description: PAC-documented price discrimination pattern — not unbundling but a related overcharging concern.
tier_5_price_discrimination.flag_message: PAC found that GL patients are sometimes charged more than cash patients for the same treatment. Ask your hospital for the cash-equivalent rate.

items.detection_signal: Bill header or patient type field shows 'GL', 'Guarantee Letter', 'GL Patient', or insurer/TPA name.
items.condition: Patient is covered by insurance or employer GL — PAC found GL patients are sometimes charged more than cash patients for identical treatment.
items.advice: Request the cash-rate equivalent bill and compare line items. If prices differ for the same treatment, query the hospital administration.
items.source: PAC 1,999-Page Report, June 2025
